rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is extremely important, essential, or vital.

example.english: Studying is crucial if you want to get a high score.
example.jyutping: jiu3 lo2 gou1 fan1 wan1 syu1 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this when the thing is decisive in determining an outcome or future, rather than merely important.

example.english: The last five minutes are crucial to the whole match.
example.traditional: 最後五分鐘係成場比賽嘅關鍵。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 ng5 fan1 zung1 hai6 cing4 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ge3 gwaan1 gin6
